questions.subject: chemistry
questions.content: The coordination number of central metal atom in a complex is determined by :

options.content: the number of ligands around a metal ion bonded by sigma bonds
the number of only anionic ligands bonded to the metal ion
the number of ligands around a metal ion bonded by sigma and pi- bonds both
the number of ligands around a metal ion bonded by pi-bonds

questions.explanation: The coordination number of central metal atom in a complex is equal to number of monovalent ligands,  twice the number of bidentate ligands and so on, around the metal ion bonded by coordinate bonds.
